Hi Sarah — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated. Short answers up front, then a suggested plan: 

- Co-sell credits: typically we apply credits on a monthly basis but run a quarterly true-up for co-sell math to handle refunds/adjustments. For buyer-facing budgets it usually shows as a steady monthly credit with a single quarterly reconciliation. We can provide a sample invoice view.
- Buyer approvals: for companies your size we commonly see a two-step pattern: central procurement (legal/PO) signs the private offer, and at least one BU approver (Tech Ops or Cloud Platform) must sign off on the technical/evidence checklist.

Suggested next steps (attached):
1) I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) and a short evidence pack (SOC2 summary + retention note).
2) Ben (CCd) can confirm co-sell credit phasing language we should put into the private offer and whether a quarterly true-up clause is acceptable from the seller side.
3) If procurement wants, we can draft two signature lanes on the PO (Procurement + BU Tech Approver) and a DocuSign workflow.

Timeline: if we get confirmation on the BU approver name by Thurs 5/28, we can deliver the PO and DocuSign link by Friday 5/29, which should fit your June 4 signoff target.

Putting Ben on this thread to confirm the PO language and credit phasing.

Thanks —
